heading: Donald Trump's daughter Tiffany is a desi Barbie in pink Manish Malhotra outfit
paragraphs: After sharing pictures from the Ambani family’s grand Ganpati celebrations in Mumbai, Tiffany Trump has now posted another set of photos from her trip to the city.
The new set of pictures also feature her son, Alexander, and mother, Marla Maples. But it is the mother-daughter duo’s ethnic fashion that has caught our attention.

Both Tiffany and Marla looked elegant in traditional outfits by designer Manish Malhotra. Tiffany looked no less than a desi Barbie in a pastel pink kurta set, complete with a dupatta and flared palazzos. Marla, on the other hand, looked elegant in a pistachio green kurta set adorned with intricate embroidery.

Tiffany’s outfit featured intricate latticework and unmissable pearl embellishments along the collar. She styled the outfit with a dazzling pair of diamond earrings. She kept her hair open and completed the look with minimal makeup.
Marla, on the other hand, added a statement choker to her look.
The latest pictures come days after Tiffany attended the Ambani family’s Ganpati celebrations, where she also embraced desi fashion in a lehenga-choli.
That was one pretty outfit too, featuring a mint green and bubblegum pink lehenga adorned with gobs of pearls.

Tiffany Trump is the fourth child of US President Donald Trump and his only child with his second wife, Marla Maples. Tiffany’s husband, Michael Boulos, also joined the family during their India visit. Tiffany and Boulos welcomed their son, Alexander Trump Boulos, in May 2025.
